- Achilles tendon stretch: Similar to the calf stretch, but with your back foot a little farther back and your knee straight. Lean forward until you feel a stretch in your Achilles tendon. Hold for 15-30 seconds, then switch legs. Repeat 3-4 times on each leg. 

- Toe stretch: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you. Grab your big toe and gently pull it toward you, feeling a stretch in the underside of your foot. Hold for 15-30 seconds, then switch feet. Repeat 3-4 times on each foot. 

- Shin stretch: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front of you. Flex your feet and point your toes toward the ceiling, feeling a stretch in your shins. Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release. Repeat 3-4 times.
